item.text: {"verdict":"request_changes","findings":[{"file":"internal/engine/prephase_conversion.go","line":119,"priority":1,"description":"The prior semantic-replay defect remains for fresh events that omit organization. After any conversion, a new create-missions or authorize-plan event with the same plan hash returns here before loading the Work or checking expected_work_revision, task state, launch locks, or release state. Reproduce by materializing without an organization, altering a task or deleting a launch lock, then submitting a new same-hash event without organization: it succeeds and records a new receipt; authorize-plan can likewise succeed without releasing anything. Exact event-ID replay is already handled in preparationCommand, so fresh events should validate current state and perform their requested transition or be rejected. Add regressions for fresh organization-less events with changed work and for authorize-plan proving locks are actually released."},{"file":"internal/engine/managed_git.go","line":137,"priority":1,"description":"A pending manifest is considered valid after JSON decoding, digest equality, and existence of prior.Base in the fixed repository, but its remaining required fields are not validated. A syntactically valid pending object with the correct request_digest and an existing base_commit, but an empty or redirected storage/source, empty candidate_commit, or inconsistent subdir, is promoted to repository.json and returned. Subsequent managed-repository code consumes prior.Storage for filesystem paths, so corrupted retained evidence can redirect operations or create an unusable repository contract. Validate the complete canonical manifest against the current request and derived storage/source/subdir before atomicWrite, including required Git object identities, and add rejection/no-rewrite tests for valid JSON with missing fields and altered Storage."}],"limitations":["No tools were used; the supplied source, diff, and test outputs were reviewed without independent execution or repository inspection.","Compatibility with the three explicitly excluded dirty files was not assessed.","The supplied passing and failing test evidence was not independently reproduced."]}
